title: Bobiverse persons — named individuals who are not Heaven replicants

id.description: Stable key. Holotank plates may later hang on persons/<id>.

name.description: Display name as the books use it (Bridget Sheehy, Theresa Sykorski).

kind.description: person = biological individual; ami = artificial body/mind that is not a Bob matrix (Charlie); replicant = uploaded human mind that is not Original Bob's Heaven line (Henry Roberts).

label.description: Short disambiguator shown beside the name — human, Deltan, Quinlan, AMI, Australian replicant, etc.

species.description: peoples.json id with kind people. Required for kind person and replicant; omitted for ami.

substrate.description: What they run on as of the end of the cited corpus. Separate from species: Bridget is human who becomes replicated; Henry is human mind on a foreign probe.

substrateFrom.description: Earliest book that may show the true substrate. Before that book (when gating), the console shows biological for change-arcs (Bridget). Entries met already replicated set this to their cite book.

role.description: Short job headline only — not a second bio. Open the cite chapter before writing it; do not invent titles.

cite.description: Chapter that establishes this entry. validate.py requires that chapter's corpus text to mention them.

note.description: Biography. Length tracks importance. Every factual claim must be supportable from the cite (or @bk paragraphs). Never book text. Never invent AMI/job classifications.

spoil.description: Latest book the bio's ungated prose draws on; later books use @bk paragraphs.

system.description: systems.json id when the person is strongly placed.

also.description: Other persons or bobs ids that share a bare name — collision pointers, not merges.
